preserve.label: 保持原风格
preserve.description: 保留参考图质感，统一为完整建模参考图。
preserve.instruction: Preserve the supplied visual style and materials, or follow the user's explicit style description when no reference image is supplied.

plush.label: 软萌毛绒
plush.description: 短绒材质、柔软体块，保留清楚的四肢轮廓。
plush.instruction: Restyle as a soft plush toy with short fine fabric fibers, rounded padded forms and subtle stitched details. Preserve the character identity and species, with clearly separated limbs and readable joint locations; avoid long fur that hides anatomy.

clay.label: 黏土手办
clay.description: 哑光黏土、简洁表面，适合先验证模型与骨架。
clay.instruction: Restyle as a matte clay figurine with smooth simple surfaces, rounded sculpted shapes and clean color regions. Preserve identity, species and recognizable silhouette. Keep limbs and joints clearly readable.

toon.label: 卡通 3D
toon.description: 简洁卡通体块与材质，保留角色辨识度。
toon.instruction: Restyle as a stylized 3D cartoon character with simple clean materials, readable volumes and restrained surface detail. Preserve the original species, identity and distinctive silhouette, and keep limbs distinct from the torso.
